assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: panoramic creator-program cover image for ECL Creator Collective landing page
Primary request: Create a premium photorealistic panoramic landscape image, 2:1 or wider, showing exactly 18 distinct fictional adult creators, ages 25-45, in three loose rows of six at an energetic but refined studio collective launch event. All 18 faces must be clearly visible and countable. The group should include diverse genders, ethnicities, body types, and creator archetypes: fitness influencers, relatable health/wellness creators, tech-minded biohackers, and lifestyle creators. They are celebrating rewards and excitement with natural smiles, raised hands, high-fives, a selfie pose, and a few seated foreground poses.
Input images: Image 1 is packaging reference only. Match the vial closely: small dark glass vial, brushed silver cap, holographic silver ECL label, blue ECL monogram, black GHK-CU text, blue 100mg text, blue powder visible inside. Do not enlarge the bottle unnaturally.
Scene/backdrop: Dark midnight premium studio environment with subtle rich turquoise accents, silver/holographic highlights, soft cobalt details, and tasteful sparse silver/turquoise confetti. Human, energetic, relatable creator-campaign feel.
Subject: 18 distinct attractive fictional adult creators in fashionable activewear, casual creator outfits, and light techwear. 4-6 foreground creators hold appropriately small sealed ECL GHK-CU vials with recognizable packaging; the vials are props for a content/campaign shoot and remain sealed.
Style/medium: High-end editorial campaign photography, believable lens perspective, authentic human expressions, polished but not over-retouched.
Composition/framing: Wide panoramic group composition, three loose rows of six, all faces unobstructed and visible, enough space for web cropping, no one hidden behind another person, no cropped heads.
Lighting/mood: Premium studio lighting, warm joyful energy, crisp facial detail, tasteful reflective highlights on holographic labels.
Color palette: dark midnight #080b10, rich turquoise #2fd4c8, silver/holographic, occasional cobalt.
Text: The only readable product text may be on vial labels: ECL, GHK-CU, 100mg.
Constraints: All people are fictional adults; no real identities, no testimonials, no medical credentials, no implication that the models used the product. Sealed vials only. No injections, syringes, dosing, administration, lab coats, before/after story, body-transformation claims, health-benefit claims, social-media UI, usernames, follower counts, income amounts, other brands, alcohol glasses, trophies, medals, or award plaques. No distorted faces or duplicated people. Must show 18 countable faces.

Keep all foreground sealed ECL GHK-CU vials unchanged, including vial size, labels, caps, blue powder, and product text.
